name: write
declaration: const unsafe fn write (self , val : T) where T : Sized ,
documentation:
Overwrites a memory location with the given value without reading or
 dropping the old value.

 See [`ptr::write`] for safety concerns and examples.

 [`ptr::write`]: crate::ptr::write()
rules: `self.as_ptr()` must be properly aligned, even if `T` has size 0.
It is safe to overwrite the contents of `self.as_ptr()` without dropping the old value, even if doing so leaks allocations or resources.
